summary: New America Acquisition I Corp., a NYSE-listed SPAC, filed a Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting entry into an Administrative Services Agreement with Dominari Holdings Inc., an affiliate of certain officers and directors, for office space and administrative services at $20,000 per month until an initial business combination or liquidation. Concurrently, the prior Administrative Services Agreement with New America Sponsor I LLC, dated December 3, 2025, was terminated via a Termination and Release Agreement. Both agreements are attached as exhibits. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction are disclosed; this is a routine administrative contract change.
